cross_component_finding: This is one of the thinnest pages in the batch (28 lines) and its entire technical content is two one-paragraph sections (creating and retrieving design documents) plus a legacy-status warning - there is no discussion of map/reduce function syntax, view querying, or stale/index-update parameters anywhere on this page, unlike a typical Views reference page.
cross_product_finding: No Java-SDK-derived sdk:* id in the supplied registry excerpt addresses Views at all, so there is nothing to test reuse against here - this page's only substantive registry hit is the server-side index-type:view id, confirming Views is documented as the same legacy mechanism regardless of which SDK's docs describe it. The one genuinely SDK-flavored concept on the page (design-document CRUD via the SDK) is minted fresh (sdk:design-document-management) since no prior round appears to have covered it from either the Java or Python side.
